calendarFaqs.q: When does Ann Arbor Public Schools start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: AAPS students start Monday, August 31, 2026. The first day is a half day for all students, with release times that vary by school level.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of AAPS in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day is Wednesday, June 16, 2027. It is a half day for all students; the PDF lists different release times for high school, middle school, K-8, and K-5.

calendarFaqs.q: When is AAPS Winter Break in 2026-27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 21, 2026, through Friday, January 1, 2027. School resumes Monday, January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: When is AAPS Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Friday, March 26, through Friday, April 2, 2027. School resumes Monday, April 5.

calendarFaqs.q: Which AAPS students have report-writing half days?
calendarFaqs.a: Elementary, K-8, and middle school students have report-writing half days October 30 and March 9 while high school students attend a full day. On May 13, only elementary and K-8 students have a report-writing half day.

calendarFaqs.q: Do all AAPS high schools use the same exam schedule?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Community, Huron, and Pioneer use semester exams, while Pathways and Skyline use trimester exams. The July PDF and August text calendar list different June dates, so families should confirm the final exam schedule with their high school.

calendarFaqs.q: Is the AAPS PSAT/NMSQT date October 7 or October 8, 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The July 6 printable PDF says October 8, while the later August 11 text calendar says October 7. The conflict is unresolved, so this event is excluded from the .ics file. Students should confirm the date and late-start schedule with their high school.

calendarFaqs.q: Is the AAPS SAT and PSAT date April 14 or April 16, 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The PDF chronology, April grid, and official text calendar say April 14; the PDF's bottom exam table says April 16. This page uses April 14, but students should confirm with their high school.

calendarFaqs.q: Do preschool and A2Virtual follow the main AAPS calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Not exactly. AAPS says preschool and A2Virtual use slightly different calendars. Families should check the program or school calendar for dates outside the district overview.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 14, 2026, against the current AAPS calendar hub, July 6 printable PDF, August 11 text calendar, six translated editions, and the district bell-schedule page.
sourceReviewDetails: The local PDF and current official direct PDF are byte-for-byte identical and share the same SHA-256 checksum.
The one-page PDF was text-extracted, rendered at high resolution, and visually checked across the chronology, month grids, bell table, commencement table, and exam table.
The 2026–27 half-day release times shown on this page come from the July 6 PDF. The district's standalone bell-schedule page is a supplemental reference and still carries a prior-year last-day label.

The July PDF says October 8 for the grade 11 PSAT/NMSQT, while the later August 11 text calendar says October 7. The conflict is unresolved, so the event is displayed with both dates and excluded from the .ics file.
The April 14 / April 16 SAT-PSAT conflict is preserved visibly; April 14 is used because the PDF chronology, April grid, and text calendar agree.

The July PDF lists June 11–15 finals for both high school groups. The August 11 text calendar lists June 11, 12, and 14–16 and says the schedule varies by school, so the .ics file excludes June final exam dates.
The translated calendars are linked as official alternate formats. Preschool and A2Virtual dates were not inferred from the district calendar.
